markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (97%)** · Confident · Careful review
Simulated frozen section favors InSitu (1% invasive risk) [F1], with all four margins positive [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 97%, Benign 1%, Invasive 1% | Strong InSitu, 1% invasive risk |
| Conformal set | InSitu (alpha 0.1) | Single class at 90% coverage |
| Reliability / OOD | 98%, OOD 1.0 (12/12 regions) [F6] | Reliable despite atypical OOD distance |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree (true) | Foundation models match top class |
| Similar cases | 5/5 InSitu (74–81%) [F5] | Nearest reference cases match |

## Tissue evidence
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 1, 6, 8) · ↓ invasive · Score 1.73 (contribution -0.79) favors InSitu (12/20 spot check) [F2] · Weak
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 10) · context · Score 0.16 (contribution +0.37), descriptive (8/20 spot check) [F3] · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 6) · ↓ invasive · Score -0.06 (contribution -0.27), unreliable (0/20 spot check) [F4] · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Top-risk region deletion beats random (0.0114 drop, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197, n=132), supporting classifier faithfulness.
- **Concepts**: Deletion overlaps zero (0.0008, 95% CI -0.0088–0.0064); unfaithful to classifier, and mitoses (0/20) is unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Focal invasion in region 1 (67% risk) or region 4 is masked by frozen-section and JPEG-3 artifacts.
- Duct-confined scores reflect normal ducts like contrast case BACH_0008 (73% similarity), or small-set calibration error (5% ECE, n=132).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 1, 4**: Rule out stromal invasion in the top risk (67%) and invasion-concept regions.
2. **Regions 1, 6, 8**: Confirm atypical cells remain duct-confined rather than invading stroma.
3. **Regions 0–3, 7, 8–11**: Verify superior, lateral, medial (108 um), and inferior (323 um) margins.
